components.name: Calculate
components.css: .ds-calculate{width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:12px 16px;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:6px;font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;transition:background-color 300ms}.ds-calculate:hover{background:#1d4ed8}.ds-calculate:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #1d4ed8;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-calculate{transition:none}}

components.name: Number field
components.description: Labeled editable value with persistent range hint.
components.html: Input range: 4.0–20.0%. This is not a treatment target.

components.name: Reading panel
components.description: White container for readable educational content.
components.html:
About A1C

A1C shows your average blood sugar over the past 2–3 months.
components.css: .ds-card{padding:24px;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#333;box-shadow:0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.1),0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.06);font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;line-height:1.5}.ds-card h2{font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.4;font-weight:600;color:#1f2937;margin:0 0 12px}.ds-card p{max-width:70ch;margin:0}

components.name: Primary navigation
components.description: White labels on the incumbent blue navigation bar.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px;padding:12px 16px;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif}.ds-nav a{padding:8px 12px;border-radius:4px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover{background:#1d4ed8}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #1d4ed8;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: More sharing
components.description: Native disclosure keeps additional actions in normal flow.
components.css: .ds-sharing{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;color:#374151}.ds-sharing summary{min-height:44px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer}.ds-share-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}.ds-share-actions button{min-height:44px;padding:8px 12px;background:transparent;color:#374151;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:4px;font:inherit}.ds-share-actions button:hover{background:#dbeafe}.ds-sharing summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #1d4ed8;outline-offset:3px}.ds-share-actions button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #1d4ed8;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Result panel
components.description: Estimate values separated from the editable form.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-result{padding:16px;background:#eff6ff;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;border-radius:6px;font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;line-height:1.5}.ds-result h3{font-size:1.125rem;font-weight:600;color:#1f2937;margin:0 0 8px}.ds-value{font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;color:#2563eb;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-result p{margin:16px 0 0;font-size:.875rem;color:#4b5563}

narrative.overview:
the incumbent
blue navigation, pale page, white calculator and familiar controls. The owner
approved refinement of this existing system, not a replacement visual world.
The useful distinction is between input, calculated estimate, and deliberate
sharing; decoration must not compete with those states.

rules.name: The State Clarity Rule
rules.body: Distinguish input, estimate and error with labels and structure as well as color.

dos: Do preserve the incumbent composition and use explicit labels and units.
Do keep input hints synchronized with the selected units.
Do expose errors/status to assistive technology without reading a toolbar.
donts: Don't overlap result text with sharing controls or leave stale results visible.
Don't imply that estimates diagnose illness or establish treatment targets.
Don't describe base64 as encryption, or intentions as compliance evidence.
